title: phaseolus minimus f. heterophyllus
intro: Phaseolus minimus f. heterophyllus, commonly known as the "wild mung bean", is a type of plant that belongs to the legume family. The wild mung bean has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to help manage diabetes, lower cholesterol levels, and reduce blood pressure. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as isoflavones, saponins, and flavonoids. These constituents have been shown to have a positive impact on cardiovascular health and may also have anti-cancer properties.
